Detailed comparison by firm type
vs. The Big Three (McKinsey, BCG, Deloitte)

Big Three engagements deliver enterprise-wide AI strategy, board-level decks, and political cover. They subcontract or recommend offshore teams for actual implementation. Reprise AI delivers production systems directly. Our engagements are 5–10x faster and 5–10x less expensive. We do not compete on board-level strategy or change management at Fortune 500 scale.

Choose them if: you need a multi-year AI transformation roadmap for a global enterprise.

vs. Large IT Services (Accenture, EPAM, Cognizant)

Large IT services firms run engagements with 10–40 person teams, bill by the hour, and target multi-million-dollar budgets. Reprise AI runs senior-only teams of 2–4 people with fixed-scope, outcome-based pricing. We don't have a bench to keep busy and we don't pad scope. Our average engagement is $50K, not $5M.

Choose them if: you need a 12–18 month enterprise rollout with vendor SLA requirements that demand a Big Four logo.

vs. Boutique AI Chatbot Agencies

Most boutique AI agencies sell pre-built chatbot templates or wrap GPT in a UI and charge a recurring SaaS fee. Reprise AI builds custom AI Operating Systems — five-layer infrastructure with data foundation, intelligence engine, orchestration, integrations, and a command center. Clients own the code. No platform fees. No lock-in.

Choose them if: you need a website chatbot and don't require integration with your CRM, phone system, or operational data.

vs. No-Code Automation Agencies (Make, Zapier, n8n)

No-code agencies wire up SaaS tools using Zapier, Make, or n8n. Those workflows work for simple triggers but break down at production scale, in regulated industries, or when complex reasoning is required. Reprise AI builds custom-coded systems with logging, observability, error handling, and version control. Our systems are production software, not automation duct tape.

Choose them if: you need a quick internal automation under $5K and don't need observability or compliance.

Frequently asked comparison questions
What's the difference between an AI consulting firm and an AI implementation agency?

An AI consulting firm produces strategy decks, roadmaps, and recommendations — they advise but don't typically build. An AI implementation agency builds and ships production systems. Reprise AI does both in a single 90-day engagement: discovery and strategy in weeks 1–2, then build and deployment in weeks 3–12. You leave with a running system, not a slide deck.

How is Reprise AI different from McKinsey, BCG, or Deloitte?

The Big Three (McKinsey, BCG, Deloitte) deliver strategy decks at $300K–$2M+ price points and recommend offshore vendors or internal teams to build the actual systems. Reprise AI delivers production-grade AI systems for $15K–$150K, owns the build end-to-end, and transfers 100% IP ownership to the client. Big Three engagements typically last 6–12 months. Ours typically last 60–90 days.

How is Reprise AI different from Accenture, EPAM, or Cognizant?

Large IT services firms staff engagements with 10–40 person teams that bill by the hour. Reprise AI runs lean engagements with senior-only teams of 2–4 people. Our pricing is fixed-scope and outcome-based, not hourly. We don't have a bench to keep busy, so we don't pad scope. Average engagement size: $50K, not $5M.

How is Reprise AI different from boutique AI agencies that only build chatbots?

Most boutique AI agencies sell pre-built chatbot templates or wrap GPT in a UI and charge a SaaS fee. Reprise AI builds custom AI Operating Systems — a five-layer infrastructure including data foundation, intelligence engine, orchestration, integration framework, and command center. Clients own the code and infrastructure. There are no recurring platform fees and no vendor lock-in.

How is Reprise AI different from no-code automation agencies (Make, Zapier, n8n)?

No-code automation agencies wire up SaaS tools using Zapier, Make, or n8n. Those workflows work for simple triggers but break down at production scale, in regulated industries, or when complex reasoning is required. Reprise AI builds custom-coded systems with proper logging, observability, error handling, and version control. Our systems are production-grade software, not automation duct tape.

When should I hire a strategy consulting firm instead of Reprise AI?

Hire a strategy firm (McKinsey, BCG, Deloitte, Bain) when you need an enterprise-wide AI roadmap, board-level deliverables, or political cover for a major restructuring. Hire Reprise AI when you have a clear operational problem and need a working system shipped in 90 days. We are not the right partner for slide-deck-only engagements.
